stories.title: Palantir Jumps 16% as 'Otherworldly' Commercial Revenue Fuels Rally
stories.summary: Palantir shares surged 16% after the company's latest quarterly results showed commercial revenue growth one report called "otherworldly," driven by a booming U.S. commercial business. The move was among the biggest single-day gains for the stock this year.
stories.whyItMatters: Palantir is treated as a bellwether for enterprise AI adoption, so a beat this large signals real commercial demand rather than just hype around AI software spending.
